criteria.description: Median assisted time per item is at most this fraction of the median baseline time.
Upper 95% bound of the reject rate over viewed suggestions is at most this.
Lower 95% bound of the share of completed runs that did not abstain is at least this.
Upper 95% bound of the share of finished runs that errored is at most this.
p95 provider latency of completed runs, in milliseconds, is at most this.

decisionReason: Template: no pilot data was supplied.
limitations: Sessions measure editor time from opening the editor to the first save; time spent elsewhere is not seen.
Baseline and assisted samples are compared as groups, not paired per item or editor.
Accept/edit/reject rates count only suggestions rendered to the editor; feedback sent without a viewing session is excluded.
Run and API-call counts are operational denominators, not user value.
Provider probabilities are not correctness probabilities unless the provider is calibrated on this data.
